keyTakeaways: Small text signs (15 to 20 inches) typically cost between $120 and $220, while wedding backdrops average $260 to $480.
Overall length of silicone LED tubing and total letter count are the primary drivers of fabrication cost.
A contour-cut or cut-to-letter acrylic backboard is standard, while colored UV-printed acrylic or waterproof outdoor sealing adds to the quote.
Modern 12V LED neon signs cost only pennies per day to run, using up to 80% less electricity than vintage high-voltage glass neon.
Always request a scaled digital mockup and an itemized quote before committing to production.
